judgments.reason: The support_span only describes a 30-mm mass in the right temporal lobe on imaging; it does not mention breast cancer or establish the etiology as breast cancer metastasis. The span alone does not clinically support the 'of breast cancer' component of the modifier.

The span 'consistent with cT4dN3M1 stage IV breast cancer' directly establishes the primary diagnosis of breast cancer with distant metastatic disease, clinically supporting that a new brain lesion in this context represents a brain metastasis of breast cancer.
